items.title: George Blanchin Interview, 1959-11-13
items.q: I can see him just like it was yesterday. And that was Santo Pecora.

ctx.x: On Galliope Street. I don't doubt it.

There's one thing that I can remember very clearly. I can see him just like it was yesterday. And that was Santo Pecora. You know, he must have learned his instrument at a very early age, because I don't think he was more than 16 or 17 years old when he was playing with Joe Focco's band at the Old Palace. And he was taking solos and bringing down the house at that time. And I can recall very clearly.
Would Joe Focco let him play jazz at the Palace? Oh, yes. I always thought of him as a legit man. Well, he was.
